description: Tournierjc TensorFold fork 53ceb126 with the exact turboderp EXL3 6.05bpw checkpoint declared by the kit. Text only: this exact checkpoint revision has no published vision sidecar, despite the kit documenting the optional conversion path. One stream reduces memory pressure for the 6.05bpw checkpoint; the EXL3 pack maps its own n-gram table from its file (the engine refuses --ple-on-ssd for it). INT8 KV, MTP and the creator’s EXL3 kernels. Memory is an estimate, not a measured qualification; physical Spark execution remains untested here.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next EXL3 6.05bpw TensorFold single Spark (tournierjc)
